gloss: tail end; rear; end of the line

definitions.gloss: tail end; rear; very back of a line or procession
definitions.explanation: The very last position in a queue, procession, or sequence. Commonly used when referring to the end of a line of people waiting, or the rear of a group or formation.

examples.japanese: {最後尾|さいごび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧です。
examples.english: The end of the line is over there.

examples.japanese: {最後尾|さいごび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please line up at the end of the line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最後尾|さいごび}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}いたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}がった→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: When I walked to the end of the line, it extended around the corner of the station.

notes:
Combines ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧ (last) and ⟦{尾|び}→尾：18068_bi⟧ (tail). The ⟦{尾|び}→尾：18068_bi⟧ character reinforces the image of the very tail end — beyond merely being "last" (⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧), {最後尾|さいごび} specifically indicates the physical end position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最後尾|さいごび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up at the back
- {最後尾|さいごび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: the person at the very back
- {最後尾|さいごび}⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧: "end of line" sign (held by staff)
- ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最後尾|さいごび}: end of a queue

USAGE:
Very commonly seen at popular restaurants, theme parks, event venues, and shops where queues form. Staff members often hold signs reading {最後尾|さいごび} to indicate where the line ends. The word carries a polite, somewhat formal register and is the standard term used in public signage.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧: last — refers to the final item in a sequence, but does not specifically mean the physical end of a line
- ⟦{後方|こうほう}→後方：19126_kouhou⟧: rear — indicates the back area in general, not specifically the tail end of a queue
- ⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧: end, tail — used for the end of a list or text, rarely for physical queues
